column1: reportAmountThis field indicates the number of UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement reports. If configured to r1, the network does not configure rxTxReportInterval and only one measurement is reported. If configured to infinity, UE periodically reports measurements according to the periodicity configured by rxTxReportInterval.
rxTxReportIntervalThis field indicates the measurement reporting periodicity of UE Rx-Tx time difference.
